deviation.why: the registered task would otherwise run `git pull --rebase --no-autostash` every 5 minutes from a worktree 195 commits behind on a blob:none promisor clone; that pull has wedged for 5 minutes in this repo repeatedly (r1255/r1264/r1271 family) and an unattended loop would wedge every tick. Code currency is owned by the master pulse / manual rounds until the worktree is caught up.
